segments.text:
V. 24.
Ye blind guides, who teach others to do as you do yourſelves, to ſtrain out a gnat—From the Liquor you are going to drink! and ſwallow a camel—It is ſtrange, that glaring falſe Print, ſtrain at a Gnat, which quite alters the Senſe, ſhould run thro' all the Editions of our Engliſh Bibles.
